notes.title: 27 new national teams and improved controller handling
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/b4db9af901cc26d557cb8f85bda9fddb3b8efa1e.jpg

Hi all!

Kopanito has been updated to v1.0.2 with many improvements and some bugfixes. Most of the improvements come from the Community's feedback.


27 new national teams

Yep, we've added another 27 national teams, including Vatican, because why not :)

Africa: Kenya, Somalia, Sudan, Uganda
Asia: Afghanistan, Bhutan, Cambodia, Hong Kong, Kazakhstan, Nepal, North Korea, Pakistan, Yemen
Europe: Belarus, Cyprus, Estonia, Georgia, Gibraltar, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Malta, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican
Oceania: Indonesia, Philippines

This gives 149 teams in total in the game.


Customizable passes

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/40196b7e7185d1e0506b8756943db880ad045fc9.jpg

Kopanito comes with two pass types: assisted (default, easier) and manual (when holding Shift/LT). You can read more about passing in the in-game Guide.

The assisted passes can be chained, but pass receiver is vulnerable and it's easier to intercept such a pass. Manual passes allows to use air shots, precisely set pass direction (on a gamepad) and gives freedom when receiving the ball.

From this version it's possible to customize passing by choosing one of the available modes per controller:

Assisted only - making manual passes won't be possible at all, good for kids.
Assisted preferred (default) - assisted passes by pressing A/S keys or A/X buttons and manual pass by holding Shift/LT when passing.
Manual preferred (reversed) - manual passes by default by just pressing A/S keys or A/X buttons and assisted passes by holding Shift/LT when passing.
Manual only - assisted passes won't be possible at all, good for advanced players.

Note: The Manual/Assisted pass toggle key/button (Shift/LT) can be customized in the controller options menu.


Disabling controllers

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/b40fb4a5f8976de2fc2308709acab1eae26437b2.jpg

Added ability to disable specific controllers in the controls options menu. Input from a disabled controller will be ignored by the game. If you have a flight stick or some kind of advanced mouse that registers as a controller, you can now disable them in the game.


Other controller-related improvements:

Pressing any key on a controller doesn't activate it anymore. Spacebar or Start button must be pressed to toggle keyboard or a gamepad. This fixes keyboard being activated when pressing keys in Steam Overlay (e.g. accepting invite).
Direction pad on a gamepad can now be used in the menu and in the game like the left stick.
Updated layout of the controller configuration screens, grouped controls by type, added headings.
Added ability to clear key assigments by pressing Delete/Backspace.
Fixed "Can't connect receiver to a signal" (thanks jose1711).


Other additions and fixes:

Fixed Tesla-copter invisible sometimes during replays.
Fixed the "Cannot set property 'value' of undefined" error (thanks Dontasciime).
No slow-motion when the ball changes direction and isn't heading into a goal anymore.
Fixed black holes after slide tackles in goals on the Indoor and Ice rink stadiums.
User performing goalkeeper's slide tackle takes control of the goalkeeper if he traps the ball (previously random user took control).
Sliding into a goalkeeper with a ball results in a hit state for the sliding player (like hitting a goal post).
Fixed invalid positioning of the ball-magnet's sparks.
Displaying gameplay hints on the loading screen.
Displaying legend under tables in some tournament screens.
Added 6 additional loading screen illustrations.


Another update on 6 April 2017 to v1.0.4
Three more issues were fixed after this news was posted:

Fixed not activating re-connected controllers (thanks muchmore777).
Fixed goalkeeper stuck in goal's post when activating Windmaker (thanks Willem Wonka).
Fixed infinite loading screen in rare cases - invalid Kenya team definition file (thanks dudeinthenorth).

Thanks for reading and have fun!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

notes.title: A Year in Early Access
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/68891dd1067d8502402989319afc031d9ba2398c.jpg

Kopanito is now more than 2 years in constant development. Everything started back in July 2014. For the first year the game was developed internally and then we decided to hit Steam Greenlight. This is also our first game!

This post is a short summary of the whole Early Access period, which is now ending (and we like summaries). Leaving Early Access is a big milestone for us too.

If you've monitored the game's progress for some time, then this post may give you a better picture of the whole development process overall. Hopefully you will find this lecture interesting.


⚽️ The Idea behind Kopanito

So why to make an arcade 2D football game in 2016? We've started working on the game in 2014. From our research it appeared that there weren't many popular arcade football games available on Steam. And having a choice is a good thing.

Clear inspirations for the game were classics such as Nintendo World Cup (graphics, crazy super-moves), Sensible Soccer and Kick Off (skill-based gameplay). We've spent countless hours on these games 20 years ago ːkopanitosmileː So why not to make something similar today?

What does skill-based mean? It means, that you need to learn the game's mechanic over time (like in real life football). You need to work out your precision and reflexes to be a better player. Luck means little in Kopanito. The better player just wins and there aren't footballer stats that can help you. You are the stats. Super-moves also are skill-based, the better you play, the more of them you gain during a match. Some super-moves can neutralize opponent's super-moves.

Kopanito is also a game that we wanted to play. To bring back fun to football games. We've made it with love, working sometimes on weekends or in overtime, being vocal on the forums and responding to the issues reported.


⚽️ Greenlit in 2015
17-26 August 2015

21 December 2015 - v0.4

"Do not concede a single goal in a match"
"Score a goal by dribbling past the goal line with the ball"
"Score a goal using the teleport super-move"
"Cancel a super-shot using the ball magnet"
and more...

League (round-robin) with 4-16 teams,
Knock-out stage only with 4, 8 or 16 teams,

The new Indoor Stadium has walls around. It means that there are no throw-ins, corner kicks and goal kicks during a match, the game is faster this way. A tournament taking place in this stadium is present in the game too.

5 400+ code commits
100+ fixed issues reported by you
20 updates on Steam

Kopanito is leaving Early Access on Wednesday, November 16. There are plans for further development and many new ideas, but it depends on the reception of the game and interest of players. Stay with us and spread the word!

This post is a short summary of the whole Early Access period, which is now ending (and we like summaries). Leaving Early Access is a big milestone for us too.

So why to make an arcade 2D football game in 2016? We've started working on the game in 2014. From our research it appeared that there weren't many popular arcade football games available on Steam. And having a choice is a good thing.

Clear inspirations for the game were classics such as Nintendo World Cup (graphics, crazy super-moves), Sensible Soccer and Kick Off (skill-based gameplay). We've spent countless hours on these games 20 years ago :kopanitosmile: So why not to make something similar today?

notes.title: Halloween update brings some cool goodies
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/16aba9b0c030d11ad3084ad325e64134c41d9035.jpg

Hi all!

Some great new features and improvements have been implemented in the game. Read about them below and have fun playing and mastering your skills. Practice makes perfect ːkopanitorobotː


Halloween goodies

You can find few new teams in the game related to Halloween: Vampires, Zombies, Werewolves and Pumpkins.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/ecc8bef59d21d26530d94cb86c8b877a530ceebf.jpg


Local friends in online matches

It's now possible for your local friends to participate in an online match. Multiple controllers can be activated, like in a local match (though there is no guarantee, that you'll be in the same team with your friends).

The shirts at the bottom right corner of the screen display status of connected controllers. The first, yellow shirt represents keyboard, the next one (red) is for the first gamepad and so on.

Press Spacebar to enable/disable the keyboard and the Start button to toggle a gamepad (like in the team selection phase before an offline match).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/e5700c708eaaff95e7b54373de27b193b785d151.jpg

You can also select multiple online modes at once when searching for a quick match.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/9d3b71bcc040d97444e24ef8b93259f5559148f2.jpg


Improved corners

Corner kicks now allow for more options. You can make a ground pass, a lob pass or a precise shot at the goal.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/c6b21d31f95f1b60d7873e9538bf420bfb85141e.jpg


Automatic passes are back

Automatic pass is where a pass receiver controlled by AI traps the ball (if possible). This feature is geared towards beginners and kids.

Automatic passes were present in the game few months ago, but then we decided they simplify gameplay, reduced possibilities, etc. and we introduced manual passes.

Actually the current system is an improved version, not exactly the same old pass system.

Automatic passes allow also to queue actions, e.g. pass the ball further or shot at the goal before the receiver traps the ball. Feel free to try this in the practice mode in the game.

Manual passes are in the game as they were before, but now the pass modifier key is required to be pressed to perform a manual pass. By default it's the Shift key on a keyboard and Left Bumper on a gamepad (the same button as used for sprinting, can be reconfigured in the options).

Fixed 'no texture' bug in tournaments (thanks Sunny/fash).
Fixed the "Cannot read property 'name' of undefined' issue with Continental League (thanks planetdestroyer).
Fixed framerate issues in team select phase for non-english languages (thanks Richard's_Mustache).
Fixed thumbnails in stadium select and ball select widgets on Mac and Linux.
Fixed lobby invite button (thanks MonkeyJug).
Fixed "g.isP2PPacketAvailable" error (thanks bkno).

What's next?
We're now focused on improving online multi-player functionality. On our TO DO list are among others:

Allow activating multiple controllers per client.
Allow to select a team in the Create Party mode (this will allow you to play against AI).
Restore goal replays in online matches.
Expand the Browse Matches screen.
Correct fame points calculation for online matches.
and more...

Thanks everyone who reported issues and gave us valuable feedback, so we could improve this game. Have fun and report more :)

notes.title: Online multi-player available now!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/d451fc7a152dfe7e1a8269070de4a6008693b7d1.jpg

Great news!
We're happy to announce that the big day has come: online multi-player modes are available to play in Kopanito! This took a few months of our hard work to complete. 

You can play with other players around the world in these modes: Duel (1 vs 1), Doubles (2 vs 2), Chaos (3 vs 3) and Complete (5 vs 5). A match will start when there are at least 2 players ready, so for the 3 vs 3 mode other players will join during play.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/37b1264a8d68c3f0bcfc3e2f24bede5f163b29b4.jpg

Create party and invite friends!
To customize a match completely, select the "Create Party" mode. It allows you to choose teams, stadium, decide of the match duration and invite friends to play against. This type of game is currently always private and invite-only.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/3ba459b36eb9a634928f28822d5d9279c1a73829.jpg

To be continued...
It's not the end of online multi-player development. We're working on additional improvements and features. Below is a list of things that will be improved next:

Better, more fluid rendering on the client-side.
Goal replays not working yet in online matches.
Better matchmaking, taking into account players distance (to reduce latency) and skill.
Add support for more local controllers in online matches.
Calculate proper fame points for all players participating in a match (currently it's broken).
Better lobby browsing screen, allow to create public custom lobbies.
Playing in co-op against AI.


Cups and leagues
Leagues screens has been improved (see the image below). For completing a cup or league additional fame points are awarded. We've also decided to unlock continental cups and World Cup for beginners.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/c3471645b221980394807e794cca1e6c9522ecbe.jpg

Supermoves rebalanced
Supershot
It can be deflected by slide tackles and standing players more easily (previously slide tackles never worked actually). Turn rate is increased when controlling the ball. Camera locked to the ball.

Windmaker
Windmaker can now stop the supershot, if it's timed correctly. This makes the Windmaker a little more useful.

Ball-Magnet
Goalkeepers can now catch the ball pulled by the Ball-Magnet most of the time. The tactic of running into an opponent's goal and activating the Ball-Magnet is now lot harder to exploit.

Other changes

Corner kicks, throw-ins and goal kicks are all now time-limited to 5 seconds.
Fixed the Team Kopanito achievement not unlocking (thanks Don Pedro De La Muerte).
Player switching improved: better algorithm, allowing to change player during a slide tackle and a failed header.
Fixed slide tackling goalkeepers.
Better stadium thumnails in the stadium selection screen.
Fixed players glitching during a header when the ball is caught by a goalkeeper.
Fixed inverted choices when setting draws for a friendly match.
Fixed conflicting global time scale related problems.
Fixed AI not recognizing it has the ball in some cases.
Fixed AI dribbling in rare cases when a human player is in the team.
Fixed goalkeeper kicking in a wrong direction in some cases.
Fixed AI making invalid ground passes in some cases.
Updated ball textures, rotated balls slightly in thumbnails.
Many more other minor fixes, optimizations and improvements.

Kopanito is still in Early Access, so remember that playing online you're testing a feature in active development. Have fun and remember to post any feedback on the forum! :)

http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

notes.title: Manual passes 2.0
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/b4db9af901cc26d557cb8f85bda9fddb3b8efa1e.jpg

Hi again!

We're back with an update that fixes many issues from the previous update. Many bugfixes has been made, but most important stuff is described below.

Manual passes 2.0

Many of you have complained about this new feature. We are confident, that we want this feature in the game, because it gives a lot more options during gameplay, so instead of stripping it, decision has been made to improve it.

Ground passes are now again on key press, not on release, so they are faster. Kick force is calculated automatically and correction has been made in detecting which teammate is the pass receiver. This greatly improves dynamics of the game.

Ball still needs to be trapped manually, but it's now bigger by 20% and player's trap range has been increased by 33%, so now it should be easier to receive a pass (although some practice is still required).


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/22a709428ac0959e3a6db80752895570037b9b6f.gif
Goal scored using the new first-touch shot feature and a manual pass into an opponent's penalty area


Shooting on one key

The [noparse][D][/noparse] key and (B) button are now used only for shooting (slide tackle has been moved to a different key, read below):

Pressing it quickly with the ball performs a direct shot (always towards opponent's goal).
Holding it with the ball enters the precise shot mode.
Holding it while running under a falling ball performs an air shot (always towards opponent's goal).
New! Holding it while running into an unowned ball on the ground performs a stronger direct shot (always towards opponent's goal).

Swapped controls

We had to move slide tackle to the [noparse][A] key[/noparse] and (X) button and air shot to the [noparse][D][/noparse] key and (B) button due to the above changes, to make things more consistent. To ensure that the game is playable for most of our community we've decided to reset customized controls, so the new keys can work properly. If you've customized your controls, then you'll need to do that again, very sorry!

The new stuff requires getting feel of it and some practice. Please be patient and report any feeback after playing at least a little longer.

If you're one of the people giving Kopanito a negative review just because of the previous update, then consider updating that review.

Notable other changes

Fixed no menu screen after losing a tournament.
Human-controlled players do not lose the ball when idle.
Improved game's behaviour regarding avatar loading when Steam is not running or it's offline (thanks udidthis).
Better AI in a human-controlled team when playing on lower difficulty levels.
Added AI level icon to the tournament menu screen.

notes.title: Last update before online multi arrives
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/a36fb4a8688e7ad4e1bccfa20c36699afd231169.png

Hi all!

Yes, we know that you want online multi-player. We've made big progress with it, but it's not ready yet, so please be patient. At the end of June or beginning of July 2016 a playable prototype should be available for testing.

A new version 0.7 is now available which introduces important gameplay improvements. We've added header shots and bicycle kicks to the game and modified the ground passes to work similarly to lob passes. This makes the game even more skill-based, so we think it's good especially when online mode will land. More about this below.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/cedfda0cefbcf1c80c9e4a57062607886e1fc77e.gif

Headers and bicycle kicks

You've requested air play and now it's ready to test. Players can now perform crazy headers and bicycle kicks during a match.

To perform one of these air shots, hold the [noparse][A][/noparse] key or (X) button while trying to stay under a falling ball. Type of shot will be selected automatically by the game depending on position of the player relative to the ball. Shot direction is always towards opponent's goal, like in regular direct shots.

Note: this feature is new and may require some rebalancing, so please report any issues or doubts on the forum.

Manual passes

Now ground passes work exactly like lob passes. The longer you hold the [noparse][S][/noparse] key or (A) button the stronger the pass. Kick direction is taken from the [noparse][▲►▼◄][/noparse] keys or (LS). Oh, and you need to receive a pass "manually", as pass receiver won't automatically run towards the ball.

This change makes the game a little more challenging, requires more precision, but also introduces more diversity in pitch situations. Kopanito is now even more skill-based. The more you play, the better you are. Hopefully this will make online multi-player more fun.

Note: this feature is new and may require some rebalancing, so please report any issues or doubts on the forum.

Other changes

Added introductory text and a new section Qualifiers to the leaderboards screen for new players.
Awarding fame for friendly matches.
Significantly reduced possibility of players being stuck in goal's net.
Revisited AI skill: made Amateur AI less accurate, made Professional and Legend AI a little worse at play, restored Beginner AI playing better when losing, otherwise it was too easy.
Displaying Steam avatar and username in game's footer.
Increased minimum fame required to advance to the Gold and Platinum leagues, respectively to 500 000 and 1 000 000 points.
Select widgets in menu now have titles.
Revisited how draws are handled in tournaments.
Disabling screen saver on game's start (thanks Sigz).
Updated icon of the teleport super-move.
Fixed crash when disconnecting a gamepad during a match (thanks el_Barto).
Ball now bounces off players that are hit on the ground.
Fixed invalid images/animations inside some alert messages.
Fixed crash when pressing [noparse][Esc][/noparse] during the loading screen.
Moved the Asia Cup to be before North America Cup on the game modes list.
Improved ball trapping, fixed some inconsistencies here, reduced a possibility of a ball passing through a player.
Removed the "Skilled" achievement.
Goalkeeper improvements:
    
    Goalkeeper can catch the ball and perform slide tackles when "returning home".
    Fixed shaking and walking in place.
    Fixed goalkeeper being idle in rare cases during a match.
    

And as always many more minor tweaks and fixes was made.

Known issues

    No Steam Overlay. It stopped working on Windows (it still isn't working on OS X and Linux too).
    Incomplete translations. We've decided to not bother our translators until the game is complete to simplify things and reduce costs. Please use english language for now.
    In rare cases there may be no fans on the stadium, only empty seats. If you experience this, then please report on the forum.


Note: please don't report issues as comments to news, because we can't respond or track them. Use Steam forums. We're reading all posts, even if we don't respond immediately.

Oh, and do not forget to infor your friends about the sale, Kopanito is now 70% off!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

Steam | Facebook | Twitter | YouTube | Official Site

notes.title: Freeze, replays and GIF generator added (again)!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/399820/extras/bug_fix.jpg

Hi all!

We've cool new features for all who aren't participating in the beta. There is a lot of players who decided to stick with the older v0.5, which was faster and more stable than v0.6 for some time. Until now, as we've decided to push this new version to all players.

The game should run very fast, actually smoother than ever. If your monitor has high refresh rate, then the game will render at this rate. Please report if it's not on the Kopanito's forum.

If you're participating in beta, then the latest changes are listed at the end of this news.


http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/1459499533643.gif

Freeze super-move

This is the fifth super-move in the game. It allows you to freeze players in radius (except goalkeepers) around the current controlled player. The longer you hold the super-move button (E key or LT button), the bigger is the radius of freezing. Note that you may also freeze your teammates too. Frozen players wont participate in the game for some time (depending how close they were to the freezing player).

This super-move can be used both offensively and defensively. You can freeze opponent's defenders to make it easier to score a goal for example. The ball can also be frozen or, actually stopped, even in mid-air. It's a good method to cancel opponent's shots, including super-shot. Try it for yourself :)

You can also slide tackle a frozen player to defrost him faster.


http://i.imgur.com/hpAXhtG.jpg

Action replays

They activate automatically after goals, but can be started manually from the pause menu. It's a side-product of online multi-player, where game state recording is needed. Since we're recording a match, we though it would be great to able to replay it. Up to last 8 seconds are recorded and can be replayed back. Note that replays aren't exact, pixel-perfect recreation of a given situation, but rather a very close approximation. This means that sometimes things may be broken during a replay (we'll fix this in future).


http://i.imgur.com/WRWH5Er.jpg

GIF generator

This feature allows you to create a GIF animation from an action replay. This was inspired by the first GIF animation uploaded by FUDO. We think it will be great feature to share all cool and funny stuff you do during a match.

Note: This feature is very experimental. It's good, but not perfect. GIF generation takes up to a few minutes to complete, so please stay patient. Generated animations are currently heavy (5-8 MB) and not so smooth. This will be improved in future assuming players' interest.

We encourage you to share your GIFs here on the Artworks section of the Community Hub or anywhere else you like around the web.

Example GIF animations:
[code]http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/ezgif-2036764242.gifhttp://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/ezgif-3737455737.gifhttp://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/ezgif-2202406948.gif
[/code]

Legend AI

This fourth difficulty level was previously hidden. We've decided to show it, but leave locked. Unlock condition is visible when starting a new cup or league.

http://i.imgur.com/kNUTAyo.jpg


Online multi-player
When? Possibly at the beginning of June 2016 alpha testing will start.


Full list of changes between v0.5.2 and v0.6.6

Improved a little appearance of the stadiums available in the game. Grass is more bushy, prominient, colors have been adjusted. Fans are now closer to the pitch. Other small changes were made too, hope you like them!
Resigned from inverting swerve direction when targeting the left goal. Many players requested this, so now you have it and we'll see how it goes.
Improved rendering of the clock's digits during a match.
Increased speed of the camera to follow the ball better.
Fixed error when loading the game in some rare cases "ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '**/messageformat.js'" (thanks Renzo via email).
Preserving leaderboards statistics when player's profile is reset (thanks Bro).
Fixed truncating replay buffer after each goal "Cannot set property 'elapsed' of undefined" (thanks MonkeyJug and pimmey).
Fixed unwanted whistle sound after a replay and restarting cheering sounds (thanks FUDO).
Fixed invalid camera zoom after replays.
Fixed invisible in-game menu at match start (thanks Skaery, MonkeyJug and FUDO).
Fixed crash when an unsupported language was specified in player's profile.
Fixed players dropping the ball during throw-ins.
Fixed not resuming match after a replay in some cases.
The Beginner AI doesn't increase its playing level when losing. Now it should be easier for newcomers.
Fixed time slowing down when passing to own goalkeeper (thanks kusmierek).
Moved the achievement notification to the left side of the screen.
Fixed AI level icon on the match summary screen.
Playing whistle sound on goals (thanks FUDO).
Fixed the supershot achievement "Cannot read property 'receiver' of undefined" (thanks Skaery).
Fixed the double slide hit challenge.
Fixed rare crash during gameplay "no ball here".
Fixed creating a texture in the fans module before renderer is created.
Added gameplay options menu with ability to toggle goal replays, goal celebration and AI indicators.
Players can now "collide" with goal's net.
Fixed left side of the leaderboards screen flickering when the table on the right side is scrolled.
Changed labels on the draws button in the friendly match settings menu from "On"/"Off" to "Draws Allowed"/"Golden Goal".
Fixed always activating keyboard in the practice mode. Now the controller last used in menus is activated by default.
Displaying most important keys at the bottom of the screen in the practice mode.
Limited number of players to only one in the practice mode to simplify things (so we could display only one set of most important keys).
Fixed extracting dynamic libraries to the OS temporary directory, which prevented the game from running in some cases (thanks mr_auer).
Corrected the Super-shot achievement to better detect scored goals (thanks Skaery).
Corrected typo in the Team Work challenge description (thanks Monkey Jug).
Small accuracy improvements in AI shooting with the precise shot.

Added walking, by default Ctrl key and RB button (suggested by MonkeyJug).
Sped-up GIF generation, using all CPU cores for this task (f you have 4 cores, then a GIF should generate 4 times faster).
Improved grass colors of some stadiums, reduced brightness, increased contrast.
Fixed missing labels on buttons in high resolutions (thanks H.o.W-Umbrella and others).
Better collision detection between goal's net and ball during replays.
Fixed crash when disconnecting controllers (thanks MonkeyJug).
Improvements in camera movement.

notes.title: Freeze, replays and GIF generator added!
notes.content:
http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/test_-_Copy_6.gif

Hi all!

Kopanito's team is back with some cool new features in v0.6 and new yet-unseen bugs (regressions)! We've worked hard past 2 months modifying most of our rendering code towards promised online multi-player. There were a lot of necessary changes in the game's code, so it's very likely that many things got broken in the process. But we think that anyway the game is reasonably stable and all regressions will be fixed in future. Now about the new features.


http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/1459499533643.gif

Freeze super-move

This is the fifth super-move in the game. It allows you to freeze players in radius (except goalkeepers) around the current controlled player. The longer you hold the super-move button (E key or LT button), the bigger is the radius of freezing. Note that you may also freeze your teammates too. Frozen players wont participate in the game for some time (depending how close they were to the freezing player).

This super-move can be used both offensively and defensively. You can freeze opponent's defenders to make it easier to score a goal for example. The ball can also be frozen or, actually stopped, even in mid-air. It's a good method to cancel opponent's shots, including super-shot. Try it for yourself :)

You can also slide tackle a frozen player to defrost him faster.


http://i.imgur.com/hpAXhtG.jpg

Action replays

They activate automatically after goals, but can be started manually from the pause menu. It's a side-product of online multi-player, where game state recording is needed. Since we're recording a match, we though it would be great to able to replay it. Up to last 8 seconds are recorded and can be replayed back. Note that replays aren't exact, pixel-perfect recreation of a given situation, but rather a very close approximation. This means that sometimes things may be broken during a replay (we'll fix this in future).


http://i.imgur.com/WRWH5Er.jpg

GIF generator

This feature allows you to create a GIF animation from an action replay. This was inspired by the first GIF animation uploaded by FUDO. We think it will be great feature to share all cool and funny stuff you do during a match.

Note: This feature is very experimental. It's good, but not perfect. GIF generation takes up to a few minutes to complete, so please stay patient. Generated animations are currently heavy (5-8 MB) and not so smooth. This will be improved in future assuming players' interest.

We encourage you to share your GIFs here on the Artworks section of the Community Hub or anywhere else you like around the web.

Example GIF animations:

http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/ezgif-2036764242.gif

http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/ezgif-3737455737.gif

http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/37/36172/ezgif-2202406948.gif

Legend AI

This fourth difficulty level was previously hidden. We've decided to show it, but leave locked. Unlock condition is visible when starting a new cup or league.

http://i.imgur.com/kNUTAyo.jpg

Other changes

Added gameplay options menu with ability to toggle goal replays, goal celebration and AI indicators.
Players can now "collide" with goal's net.
Fixed left side of the leaderboards screen flickering when the table on the right side is scrolled.
Changed labels on the draws button in the friendly match settings menu from "On"/"Off" to "Draws Allowed"/"Golden Goal".
Fixed always activating keyboard in the practice mode. Now the controller last used in menus is activated by default.
Displaying most important keys at the bottom of the screen in the practice mode.
Limited number of players to only one in the practice mode to simplify things (so we could display only one set of most important keys).
Fixed extracting dynamic libraries to the OS temporary directory, which prevented the game from running in some cases (thanks mr_auer).
Corrected the Super-shot achievement to better detect scored goals (thanks Skaery).
Corrected typo in the Team Work challenge description (thanks Monkey Jug).
Small accuracy improvements in AI shooting with the precise shot.
A lot of other fixes and minor improvements, but some regressions too.

This is not an April Fools' Day joke, in case you are wondering :) Thank you and have fun!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

notes.title: Kopanito gets leaderboards and match challenges
notes.content:
Hey there, we have some new features for you! In three weeks we were able to implement cool leaderboards and match challenges. Now playing tournament matches (alone or in co-op) will give you fame points. Completing match challenges will give you even more fame. The more fame you have, the higher you will be in the global ranking.

Leaderboards
We've integrated Steam Leaderboards with the game, but not as a single big table, but as 4 leagues. You start in the Bronze League and by winning tournament matches (alone or in co-op) you gain fame points. Advancing to a higher league requires to accumulate given amount of fame shown on the leaderboards screen, different for each league.

Note: friendly matches won't give you any fame points right now, but this may change in the future.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3078/3077275/profile/leaderboards.png

Match Challenges
These are optional objectives than can be fulfilled during a tournament match. There are many challenges with varying difficulty levels, e.g. score a hat-trick or knock-out two opponents with a single slide tackle. Some harder challenges will appear only on higher difficulty levels, so playing on Beginner will show you only the easiest challenges. More challenges may come in future, along with achievements.

Note: Challenges don't appear during friendly matches, but that may change in the future.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3078/3077275/profile/challenge.jpg

Trading cards
This is a matter of a few days for the trading cards to be available. We've all graphics prepared and will upload cards, badges and other related stuff ASAP.

Future plans
We have a long list of features to implement, small and big ones, some of them suggested by players, but there is one most important feature still missing: online multi-player. This is a big thing for us and we'll need at least a few months to complete it. During this time you may see less frequent updates of the game regarding other features.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3078/3077275/profile/goals.jpg

Full list of changes

Added Leaderboards feature, with 4 different leagues a player can be in, integrated with Steam
Added Match Challenges, which are additional objectives to complete during a tournament match
Added scored goals info to match avatars, including icons for hat-tricks and top scorer (visible on the above image)
Made the AI on Professional and Legend a little faster and aggressive
Fixed controller mapping on Linux, if you've customized your mapping, you can now reset to the default one and it should work
Added marker for tournaments in progress
Added marker for recently unlocked items
Added Italian translation of the game
Corrected Russian translation (thanks Деня Селин)
Increased size of all menu screens in resolutions lower than full HD (1920x1080), so text is more readable
Reduced tournament default match time to 4 minutes
Displaying english string if a translation wasn't found
Fixed crash when multiple profiles are present in the "data/profiles" directory
Other minor fixes and improvements

Thank you and have fun! :) Oh, and remember to post any feedback on our forum, here on Steam.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

notes.content:
First update to Kopanito has landed and we've great news!

Poznań Game Arena 2015
Kopanito received an award at Poznań Game Arena 2015, a gaming event that took place in Poznań, Poland in October.
http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/399820/extras/pga_revelation.png?t=1448462664&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/399820/extras/pga_revelation.png?t=1448462729

4 Difficulty levels
Previously only easy AI was available, but now there are 3 more, giving a total of four of them: beginner, amateur, professional and legend (the last one must be unlocked by completing some cups). Hopefully playing with this new AI will be a challenge for you, although the game is still in early access, so we'll need your feedback regarding the new AI.

http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/399820/ss_bfcd5137a998ed20e966e3266ca87eef37b57fcd.600x338.jpg?t=1448462664&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/399820/ss_bfcd5137a998ed20e966e3266ca87eef37b57fcd.600x338.jpg?t=1448462729

Linux and SteamOS support
This is very experimental, so please let us know if it's working or not for you. One known issue: Steam overlay does not work :(

http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/399820/ss_d6fd2d14eceaaaf8d805370ea4e236b1baf4c0dd.600x338.jpg?t=1448462664&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/399820/ss_d6fd2d14eceaaaf8d805370ea4e236b1baf4c0dd.600x338.jpg?t=1448462729

Localization support added
We've added support for translations and translated the game to 5 additional languages: German, Japanese, Polish, Russian and Spanish. If you know any of these languages well, then we encourage you to verify these translations and report any feedback on game's Steam forum. Also note that you can translate Kopanito to your native language, it's very easy, just check how other languages are defined in the data/languages subdirectory in Kopanito's local files.

http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/399820/ss_0be96be8f8242c9ac166310b37cab702ae828607.600x338.jpg?t=1448462664&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/399820/ss_0be96be8f8242c9ac166310b37cab702ae828607.600x338.jpg?t=1448462729

9 new competitions to complete (all optional): Pacific League, Microstates Cup, Central American and Caribbean League, Pan Arab League, Commonwealth Cup, Pan American League, Mediterranean League, Continental League and World League.
3 additional difficulty levels, along with the previous one gives 4 levels: Beginner, Amateur, Professional and Legend. The last one is unlocked after winning main continental competitions and World Cup on Professional difficulty.
New cup animation when finishing a tournament.
Unlocking teams and other content now works differently. Depending on a cup and difficulty level, different teams are unlocked. Previously it was required to win with a team in a tournament match. Now winning a tournament unlocks given batch of teams, depending on difficulty level.
10 New teams: Angola, Bulgaria, India, Israel, Luxembourg, Morocco, Northern Ireland, Puerto Rico, Republic of Ireland and Thailand.

How to Play – new guide available in the game, describing some basic and advanced techniques.
Linux and SteamOS support.
Improved player’s look, it’s a little more detailed now.
Locked content (teams, stadiums, balls, tournaments) now display it’s condition required to unlock.
Lob pass distance is now dependent on key press time: the longer you press key, the longer the pass will be.
Goalkeeper with ball will evade opponents when putting ball back in play.
Ability to set match time in a tournament (previously it was hardcoded 10 minutes).
Highlighting qualifying teams in group stage in a tournament.
Ability to enable golden goal for friendly matches.
More granular match time options.

Added digital clock to the match UI.
Added displaying match summary after first half.
